name: 四支装多口味滋润唇膏礼盒款

category.leaf: 多口味四支装保湿润唇膏

description: 挂卡组合陈列、口味食材分镜、质地微距与新旧对照的多支护唇套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF sweep for the packshot family, warm ivory boards #F5F1E6 and #F2EDE3 for overhead screens, one saturated tinted ground #F6C021 or #5AA6D3 when a flavour block needs its own color
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with generous fill, soft contact shadows only, gentle shoulder speculars on the tube caps, around 5600K with a warm lift outdoors
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte ivory laminate board #F0EADB for flat screens, a low-gloss reflective sheet #F2EDE4 for the lineup shot, sunlit grass and open sky for scene shots
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for labels and callouts, placeholder-only in-image wording, no serif display lettering and no handwriting
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent color #D62B3A, badges drawn only as empty double-ring outlines with no filled-in marks
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale with the label face turned to the camera; variant tubes always upright in a row, side by side in the pack, or laid on easy diagonals in overhead screens; caps always off-frame or placed as a separate prop, never mid-swipe
noDrift: no color palette changes outside the locked hexes
no mixed fonts and no serif display lettering
no inconsistent lighting or hard cast shadows
no filled-in badges, seals, ratings or origin marks
no props that cover the product label
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sunny apothecary lip-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F5F1E6, saturated yolk yellow #F6C021, berry red accent #D62B3A and clear-sky blue #5AA6D3; bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, generous fill and soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif type family with placeholder-only in-image wording; thin single-weight line icons and empty outline badges; stable product scale with the label face turned to the camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no filled-in badges or seals.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清这是多支护唇组合装，赢下首图点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, hang-tab pack upright, variant tubes side by side, full pack visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light from front-left with a white fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under the pack foot
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The retail hang-tab pack stands upright in a straight-on eye-level view, the variant tubes side by side inside it, the whole pack visible and unclipped. Bright even high-key studio light from front-left with a white fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow only under the pack foot. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The pack occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no wordmarks or brand marks, no hang-tag copy, no QR codes, no hands, no props, no watermark, no extra text, no tinted or gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating pack without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 俯拍散开放大的组合主体，用引线空框一秒交代核心利益点。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: soft top light with a broad fill, short soft shadows under each tube
shots.props: one loose cap lying beside the tubes, hairline leader lines to blank rounded callout frames, one empty double-ring seal outline upper right
shots.whitespace: quiet space held around all four corners for callout frames
shots.textZone: 四角引线空框位与右上空圆章
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce overhead benefit screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the loose tubes scattered on easy diagonals across a warm ivory board #F5F1E6 with one cap lying beside them. Soft top light with a broad fill, short soft shadows under each tube. Thin hairline leader lines run from the tubes to blank rounded callout frames carrying only the placeholder wording 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, and one empty double-ring seal outline sits in the upper right with its center left blank. The product group occupies 50-60% of the frame, with clean margin kept around all four corners. Negative: no filled-in badge wording, no certification or rating marks, no ranking or usage-duration claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated tubes, no shadows longer than the objects.

shots.intent: 用膏体本体的蜡质纹理与抹痕证明肤感，替代任何功效话术。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, camera low and skimming the smeared surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: low skimming light from the left with a sweeping highlight across the ridges, no harsh speculars
shots.background: the balm mass fills the frame and its torn edge falls to a matte sand ground #E9DFCD
shots.whitespace: minimal, one calm central band kept open
shots.textZone: 中央空白标题带与三条空标签线
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the balm texture dispensed from {product}, tight zoom on the smeared waxy surface and its swipe ridges. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The camera sits low and skims the surface with shallow depth of field, near edge crisp and far edge dissolving. A low skimming light from the left throws a sweeping highlight across the ridges, no harsh speculars. The balm mass fills the frame and its torn edge falls to a matte sand ground #E9DFCD. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with a calm central band left open for one placeholder headline 「{selling_point_1}」 above three blank short label lines. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented ingredient names, no numeric or percentage claims, no oily plastic sheen, no crumbs or debris, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 用同框双包与箭头的更替结构承接换新预期，主张全部留空。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, two packs upright side by side at identical scale and identical crop
shots.lighting: even soft studio light from the front-left, matched exactly on both sides, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one thin curved arrow between the packs, two small blank rectangular label plates above them
shots.whitespace: balanced side margins and an open headline band at the top
shots.textZone: 两包上方空标牌位与顶部空标题区
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce two-panel packaging-transition comparison of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with the earlier and the current version of the same retail pack standing upright side by side at identical scale, matched framing and matched crop on both sides. A single thin curved arrow points from one pack to the other, two small blank label plates sit above them with only the placeholder wording 「{callout_3}」 on one plate, and a clean headline band is left open across the top. Even soft studio light from the front-left, identical on both panels, with soft contact shadows under each pack. Pale ivory field #FAF7F1 across the whole frame. The two packs together occupy 50-60% of the frame with balanced whitespace at the sides. Negative: no real competitor marks, no before-after efficacy claims, no dates or version numbers, no invented copy, no mismatched lighting or scale between the panels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 手持单品对天空的仰拍代入随身补涂，留出大面积文案空间。
shots.camera: photographed from a low angle looking upward, tube at the left third
shots.lighting: bright direct daylight from the upper right with a soft bounce on the shadow side
shots.background: clear open sky #5AA6D3 with a few soft high clouds
shots.props: one hand with short clean nails holding the open tube
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 45% for copy

shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a hand holding {product} up against a wide open sky. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking upward, the tube pinched between short clean fingernails at the left third of the frame with the cap off and the label face turned to the camera. Bright direct daylight from the upper right with a soft bounce on the shadow side, real skin texture kept visible. Background is clear open sky #5AA6D3 with a few soft high clouds. shots.intent: 补涂动作的真实使用瞬间，让买家把自己代入日常护理习惯。

shots.lighting: warm golden-hour sun from the right, soft shadow under the jaw, natural skin texture

shots.props: the open tube raised to the lips, one necklace edge just visible at the frame bottom
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle application scene of {product}, framed from the nose down so only the lips, chin and hand are visible and no identity can be read. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Handheld framing with a slight dutch tilt, off-center. Warm golden-hour sunlight from the right with a soft shadow under the jaw, real skin texture and fine lip detail kept. Background is a sunlit meadow blur #8FB98A under a thin pale sky band. The product and hand occupy 40-50% of the frame with no added whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face, no celebrity likeness, no retouched plastic skin, no smeared gloss artefacts, no extra fingers, no in-image copy, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 2x2 分格让每支护唇住进自己的食材世界，一次交代可选口味。
shots.camera: each panel straight-on eye-level with one upright tube centered in its quadrant
shots.lighting: soft directional studio light from the left, identical in direction and strength across all four panels
shots.background: four tinted quadrant grounds: yolk yellow #F6C021, berry red #D62B3A, clear-sky blue #5AA6D3, soft sand #E9DFCD
shots.props: per panel one produce pair: a rough honey chunk with a mint sprig, whole and halved berries, one dark cured pod with a pale blossom, one cracked nut half with a sliced stone fruit
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant storyboard of {product} laid out as a clean two-by-two grid, four equal panels separated by hairline white gutters. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each panel shows one upright variant tube at a straight-on eye-level view, centered, its cap color matched to the produce beside it. Soft directional studio light from the left in every panel, consistent in direction and strength across all four, with gentle contact shadows. Panel grounds are yolk yellow #F6C021, berry red #D62B3A, clear-sky blue #5AA6D3 and soft sand #E9DFCD. Props per panel: a rough honey chunk with one mint sprig, a heap of whole and halved berries, one dark cured pod with a pale blossom, one cracked nut half with a sliced stone fruit. Each tube occupies 40-50% of its panel with no extra whitespace. Negative: no repeated produce across panels, no mismatched light direction between panels, no flavour names or claims in image, no bruised or mouldy fruit, no crushed packaging, no watermark, no fake logo.

Figure and tube occupy 40-50% of the frame with clean space reserved on the right. shots.lighting: soft high-key light from the front-left with a bright fill card, gentle gradient only inside the reflection
shots.background: glossy reflective sheet #F2EDE4 with mirrored reflections against a pale wall
shots.whitespace: clear margins across the top headline band and the bottom offer bar
shots.textZone: 顶部空标题带与底部空优惠条
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}: the variant tubes lined up as a receding diagonal row on a glossy reflective sheet #F2EDE4, each cap a different color. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle at ground level so the nearest tube reads large and sharp while the far end melts into soft bokeh, with clean mirrored reflections under the row. Soft high-key light from the front-left with a bright fill card, gentle gradients kept only inside the reflection. A blank headline band across the top carries only the placeholder wording 「{selling_point_4}」, and a plain empty offer bar at the bottom carries 「{callout_7}」. The receding row occupies 50-60% of the frame with clear margins top and bottom. Negative: no discount percentages or countdown timers, no total range counts or collection claims, no jammed duplicate tubes, no warped straight lines, no cluttered props, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 挂卡盒装四支组合立于近白底；002 同框双包加弯曲箭头的新旧装潢更替对照；003 2x2 分格，每格一支直立于对应食材道具中（蜜块加薄荷、成堆浆果、深色豆荚加浅色花、开裂坚果加切片水果），四格各自单色底；004 纯黄底模特笑脸加左侧多行说明文字；005 顶视散装四支对角散落，四周引线连空框与右上双圆章；006 象牙色膏体抹痕满幅微距叠中央标题与三行说明；007 手持单品仰拍蓝天，右侧大字标题；008 户外田野对镜补涂瞬间；009 田野人物叠六边形细线框、双圆章与三组图文；010 顶视平铺四支配各角食材，左下大字；011 低机位镜面反射上一排纵深排列的多色单品；012 挂卡盒与四支散装等高并排；013 挂卡背板，含方形二维码、四枚细线图标加标签行、无添加条与四段成分文字、底部网址与版权行。品类判定依据：全部为保湿护唇膏体产品，画面主张集中在补涂、质地与口味选择，无着色彩妆表现，故归「护肤个护 / 面部护理」的唇部护理，而不取源类目可能挂的彩妆唇部；源图为纯产品与材质陈列，判为视觉加情感驱动的品牌套图。非变体画廊判定：多数图为结构互不相同的独立分镜（信息版面、质地微距、新旧对照、使用瞬间、背板图标、纵深阵列），仅口味阵列两镜属色卡式陈列，故按正常转化并把口味阵列做成 VARIANT 镜。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、黄管装潢上的全部字标、002 与 004 至 011 的英文原句与天然来源及无添加列表、005 与 007 的销量与排名类社会证明及脚注统计口径、009 的推荐徽章与兔形认证图形、011 的口味总数、012 与 001 的净含量与支数标注、013 的二维码、网址、地址电话、版权行与四段成分表、各图 Amazon 角标与星级；产品一律以 {product} 占位，资质位改为空白圆章与空参数线。
